title: Notification regarding Single Bench matters of Hon'ble the Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh to be listed on 20-08-2026 will be taken up on the same day before Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma.
text:
KEY LINES:
20-08-2026 will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 19th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Single Bench matters of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh to be listed on
20-08-2026 will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A. Guneshwar Sharma for fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking up
urgent matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
\Ic REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ /gaS 3 Pr Imphal, the 19th August, 2026
